about: The District of North Vancouver is a district municipality on Burrard Inlet’s North Shore, wrapping around the much smaller City of North Vancouver. It is largely residential and forested, climbing from shoreline neighbourhoods such as Deep Cove and Lynn Valley into the North Shore mountains. Capilano, Lynn Canyon, Grouse Mountain, and Mount Seymour all sit inside or on the edge of the district—not in the City. About 88,000 people live in the district.
seoSummary: North Shore district municipality of mountains and forest, including Deep Cove, Lynn Canyon, and Grouse.
knownFor: North Shore mountains and forested residential neighbourhoods
Capilano Suspension Bridge and Grouse Mountain
Lynn Canyon and the Seymour River valley
A separate government from the City of North Vancouver
